title: P20 first chain: the real-300 run lost a batch to a harness hang (timeout 1800 s, harness rc=-1); FORM-INCOMPLETE stopped the driver; C4 was re-run alone
what_went_wrong: evidence/p20/chain/c4_driver.log: oracle[real] real run exit=4 elapsed=2417s; the oracle log shows 'stage-content-hash ... batch 2027-02-19' at 13:17:29, then '[timeout 1800s] WRITER-DEAD-PROOF pgid=588053 group_empty=true' and 'date 2027-02-19: FAILED (harness rc=-1) - pre-reset state restored (hash-verified), run stops (P5-2)'. The remaining batches stayed pending. form[real]: sukses=true 115, sukses=false 0 (of 300).

The driver printed FORM-INCOMPLETE[real] (the A13 gate of P17), 'P15E FAILED fixture_rc=4 real_rc=10', exit 1; the real comparator then reported 115/300 (fresh-B ok 115); asserts-failed=2 (p13 positive exit, real compare exit). Everything else in the chain was 0: lib, P15-P20 controls, p17/p18/p19/p20 B, line controls, B6, suite 39/39, preservation, unit 44/44, NC 5.

Cause of the hang: not established. A Java GUI harness under Xvfb stuck on one batch (the system load during that run was not recorded; nothing else of mine ran on the box at the time); the previous C4 runs (P18, P19, and the P20 rerun) took about 1,566 s for the 300 visits. The oracle's timeout, kill and writer-dead proof worked as designed (xml and grants restored, stage restored hash-verified, clone kept).
root_cause: Not established (P21 correction of 'environmental flake, not a product defect', which the data does not show: the harness log of that batch and the system load were not kept). No P20 byte runs inside the oracle batch loop (the lib functions run before and after it). The gates (timeout, WRITER-DEAD-PROOF, hash-verified stage restore, FORM-INCOMPLETE) did their job. It is nevertheless a reminder that the 300-visit run is not deterministic in wall time.
detection: Chain step 3 output; the A13/FORM-INCOMPLETE gate.
impact: One extra run (about 30 minutes) and the first chain's C4 evidence is a recorded failure; the C4 rerun (same commands as steps 3-3c, 3g, 4e, 5 of the frozen chain, in an ad hoc script, evidence/p20/rerun.log.txt) passed: fixture 27/27, real 300/300, asserts-failed 0.

correction.applied: C4 re-run alone on the same frozen bytes; both runs kept in the evidence; stated in R5 section 32.

rule: A run that is stopped by a safety gate is a result, kept and reported; the re-run uses the same commands and is labelled as a re-run, and the final live-state proof is taken after it.
